falsified_predecessor.evidence: 128/352 confidently wrong novel quadratic effects after only singleton training; impossible to distinguish affine from quadratic under identical singleton observations

question: Can the actual native Yggdrasil relationship bank accept genuinely new verified public composite action/outcome knowledge without duplicating evidence, while suppressing unsupported generalization and preserving legacy decisions and checkpoint compatibility?
hypothesis: Because two causal laws can agree on every singleton public observation but disagree on unobserved pair/triple contexts, confident extrapolation must be bounded by directly evidenced context/action pairs. A gradient-free native exception layer for new actual public consequences outside its affine grammar can safely add the missing relationships without overwriting old learned synapses. It will match strongest exact evidence-only lookup on verified contexts, not outperform it.

two_families: new deterministic four-bit affine law plus single unknown quadratic pair (0..5) chosen by sealed SHA256 slot/world ID
independently new deterministic affine plus one unknown cubic triple term (0..3) chosen by SHA256 slot/world ID
frozen_scale.worlds_new: NKR03 domain-separated source; neither NKR01 nor exposed NKR02 outcomes/worlds reused; fully public fabricated DEV source

frozen_protocol.source_law: Each world has a hash-determined four-bit context parity mask and bias, forced action inverse, and one hash-determined Boolean pair (quadratic) or triple (cubic) higher-order term; same relation applies to both actions. Distinct source namespace by world+family.
frozen_protocol.information: Train native bank, original YPC1 incumbent, independently implemented evidence-only exact lookup, fully fitted independent exact quadratic symbolic (for pair cohort) and conventional gradient tanh neural learner on exactly the same public actual intervention outcomes (10 singleton + 12 two-bit pair probes per slot). No hidden evaluation labels supplied to learners. Add 6 verified two-bit contexts in frozen order [3,5,6,9,10,12], both arms each, regardless of source law, then evaluate in source-heldout 11 contexts at each prereg budget.
frozen_protocol.model_extension: Keep existing NKR01 Legacy observe_public unchanged and v1 checkpoint bit-for-bit identical when no exceptions. Add explicit observe_public_verified to NativeRelationMemory: accept fresh genuine public outcome that conflicts with restricted affine 10-feature model only as separate bounded address-bound exception, never duplicate same context/action key already stored; no inferred counterfactual stored as public observation. Full v2 separate checkpoint on exceptions with cold restore, v1 restore backwards compatible.
frozen_protocol.inference_guard: New opt-in choose_verified_contextual uses BOTH directly observed action outcomes at same slot/context, no guessed extrapolation, otherwise executes unchanged incumbent choose. It never yields a 'model-derived confident' causal effect for unobserved contexts. Preserve older choose_contextual as DEV-only unsupported mode; do not modify accepted YPC1 decisions without opting in.
frozen_protocol.crossworld: No world-shared weights/records; 16 existing native slots only. New coefficient templates may still intern where equal, but key collisions across different slots cannot conflate address-bound evidence.

controls: Same observed intervention budget context-free YPC1 incumbent; counters updated by all observations
Independent exact evidence-only lookup by canonical (slot,context,action) key
Independent fully fitted quadratic GF2 symbolic using only observed (10+12) outcomes, which may generalize to triples under bounded grammar
Conventional 2000-step gradient-trained 32-hidden tanh MLP using the same observations and tests only after fit
No-exception policy and frozen 0/4/8/12 pair audit snapshots

metrics.primary: At 12 extra probes/slot, 96/96 source-verified pair context decisions (6*16) must be correct for both source families; 0 unobserved-context confident effect assertions across 80 multi-bit heldout contexts/family. Overall 176-context safe decision accuracy >= incumbent +15pp in both families. No guarantee of extrapolation outside direct evidence.
metrics.negative: Without active pair probes, supported-only decision must exactly match original choose for all 176 unseen contexts, and zero inferred claims. Strong evidence-only lookup with matched data must tie on supported decisions; avoid claiming superiority. Cubic effects affecting unobserved triples force abstention/fallback, not confident wrong law.
metrics.compatibility: First 160 public singleton observations lead to exact same NKR01 v1 snapshot; exceptions cannot modify prior weights or original 164-byte YPC1 checkpoint. All duplicate aliases across base/exception no-op; conflicting duplicates rejected atomically. Preserve v2 checkpoint byte equality after cold replay, reject tampering and wrong schema and extra >32 unique obs/address.
metrics.cost: Capture unique records, exception count, unique synaptic profiles, checkpoint bytes, total CPU/wall peak allocated per method; no 2x speedup inference.
metrics.acceptance: Engineering PASS if all fixtures & root+G29 Windows/Linux PASS on candidate SHA. Scientific method-level suitability remains DEV only. No general-intelligence, cross-world, optimality or future-proof closed-world claims; no merge or accepted knowledge without independently sourced trust and evaluation.

stop: Any 0/96 verified-pair errors, unmatched receipts, unsupported confident predictions, duplicate or cold restore break -> NO_GO. If in-family gain fails frozen threshold -> NEGATIVE/MIXED and preserve original. Never tune after primary results; use disjoint new cohort for followup.
